text_block_list.text:
Having run through the Junior Class, the 
New Year arrived. As for Mejiro Ardan at 
the dawn of the Classic Class—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—Here's the Twinkle Series Trending News! 
Next, let's introduce this person!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"The up-and-coming young lady of the 
Mejiro family, Mejiro Ardan-san~!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
""Mejiro Ardan-san, who debuted last year, 
isn't just an Umamusume of the Mejiro 
family—she is actually the younger sister 
of the famous Mejiro Ramonu!""

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, when you have an older sister who's 
a living legend, the pressure to perform 
must be immense. I bet plenty of fans are 
dreaming she'll follow in her sister's 
footsteps."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Even on social media, everyone's 
attention is focused on how close she can 
get to Mejiro Ramonu's record—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to another wonderful year 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you were watching the television. 
This is—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, it'll certainly be tough. After 
all, she's the first Triple Tiara winner 
in history. Matching that won't be an 
ordinary feat—”
choice_data_list: Sorry. I'll put it out right away.
Sorry. I'll turn it off right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry about me. I'm used to 
being compared to my sister, so words like 
that are fully expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...And it is also a fact that the trails 
of light I leave behind fall far short of 
my sister's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That said... I have no intention of 
becoming complacent with that fact.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Along the path ahead, I intend to forge 
forward so that my own trail of light may 
be etched into everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to you, Trainer, I was able to 
steadily build upon the 'here and now' 
throughout the Junior Class."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, I take pride 
in the journey that brought me to this 
day. And so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry too much about it 
either, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, speaking of which, would it be all 
right if I said something?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Regarding my—no, *our* path forward in the 
Classic year, there is something I would 
like to share with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I want to challenge 
during the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... that's still a bit far 
off. It feels a little presumptuous of me 
to talk about it yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So by the time the spring Classic campaign 
draws near... if I complete my "warrior's 
pilgrimage" to build my body and gain the 
experience to fight in GⅠs, and remain in 
good health—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So, would it be alright if I consulted you 
about something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Did that sound... strange after all? I was 
always saying "now is the time" or "is it 
now?", and then suddenly I'm talking about 
the future—
choice_data_list: No, it's the other way around.

text_block_list.text:
The weight of Mejiro Ardan's resolve 
staked on a fleeting moment is her 
greatest merit and strength. I know that 
full well. But—

Seeing her look toward the "future," even 
just a little, and put it into words made 
me feel somewhat happy inside.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the day you come to 
me for advice.

I'm looking forward to the day you come to 
me for advice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad to hear you say that. I'll 
continue to be in your care."

Afterward, just as Mejiro Ardan and I 
finished reviewing her upcoming training 
schedule and took a breather—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you have some free time after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, there's a little favor 
I'd like to ask...
choice_data_list: It's open, but is something the matter?
It's open, but is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since we're meeting like this for the New 
Year, why don't we do something 
appropriately festive together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, I spend the New Year with the 
other Mejiro children, but this year, I 
thought I would change things up a little 
and refresh my mindset..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you are alright with it, Trainer... 
what do you think?

It was a slightly unexpected suggestion, 
but it might be just what she needs to 
unwind. Thinking of something fitting for 
New Year's—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! Fukuwarai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful, let's definitely do 
it! Is the whole set in the Trainer's 
office?
choice_data_list: Y-You look pretty happy about that.
Y-You look pretty happy about that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm ashamed to say that because I've 
spent most of my time alone, I'm not 
really used to hanging out with others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So... when you invite me out to play like 
this, I just can't help feeling happy...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is this unladylike of me?
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.text:
Seeing an unexpected side of the usually 
composed Mejiro Ardan made me quite happy 
as well.

Afterward, we pulled out a recreational 
Fukuwarai set from the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the nose? If so, then going 
from here... Um, the position of the eyes 
is...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Alright. All done!

The face Mejiro Ardan put together was... 
quite uniquely different compared to the 
original.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Kh, fufu...! It's completely different...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't this surprisingly difficult? 
Next is your turn, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's see what you've got...!

And so, sharing a few laughs along the 
way, I spent a delightful New Year's with 
Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day has passed, but it feels so 
wonderfully festive for the start of the 
year. I like it too.

I believe the academy cafeteria was 
serving a variety of limited-time ozoni 
for the New Year. I thought it would be 
nice to have some, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, that ozoni... would you let 
me make it for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To express my daily gratitude, I was 
hoping I could treat you to our family's 
style of ozoni, Trainer-san...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have received lessons from Baaya, so I 
would never serve anything inedible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

It was another sudden proposal that took 
me a bit by surprise, but as Mejiro 
Ardan's Trainer, I couldn't ignore what 
she wants to do "right now"...
choice_data_list: Then I think I'll take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much. Well then, shall 
we prepare the ingredients?

Afterward, Mejiro Ardan borrowed 
ingredients and kitchen space in the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting. Please, enjoy your 
meal.

—The ozoni served was packed with 
ingredients, an appetizing dish with the 
fragrant aroma of dashi and soy sauce.

The ingredients were neatly cut to be easy 
to eat, and the mochi was grilled to 
perfection, showcasing Mejiro Ardan's 
meticulous craftsmanship. However—
choice_data_list: (...Wait, is the flavor a bit light?)

text_block_list.text:
It's not that it tastes bad at all. It's 
delicate, and feels gentle on the body. 
However, on the other hand... it also 
feels a bit plain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Was the flavor a bit too light for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— You don't need to worry yourself on 
my account, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for this. It seems my bad 
habit has reared its head once again."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For some reason... my cooking always turns 
out on the bland side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I was in the hospital for 
so long, I got completely used to flavors 
that are easy on the body. Even the food I 
cook ends up tasting like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister used to tease me in the past, 
saying my cooking 'tasted just like 
hospital food from back in the day.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I finally had the chance to cook a meal 
for you, Trainer, and now it's completely 
ruined.

Just getting to see a new side of Mejiro 
Ardan made this ozoni, to me—

This taste is another piece of the 
"present" she has built up. There's no way 
it wouldn't be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Such a truly kind person.

Afterward, while eating ozoni together, we 
chatted about trivial things and enjoyed a 
peaceful start to the new year—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Kite flying...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful suggestion, let's 
definitely do it!
choice_data_list:
Y-You're pretty eager about this, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, um... I have never done it 
before. Flying a kite, that is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I rarely played outside when I was little, 
so sometimes I'd gaze longingly at kites 
flying far away in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And so the years went by without any 
chance to partake, leading up to where we 
are today—
choice_data_list: Then let's fly kites with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes. Gladly!

After pulling out a recreational kite and 
arriving at a park near the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my heart's starting to race a 
little. I wonder if I'll be able to fry it 
well?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey hey! Did you older girls come to fly 
kites too?”

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it together! We're super good at 
flying kites!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Thank you so much for the 
invitation. This is my very first time 
kite-flying—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Wait, for real?! Then we'll teach ya!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Well, first we decide who holds the kite 
and who flies it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—We did it! Trainer, our kite is soaring 
high in the sky!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Let's fry some too!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Let's see who can jump the highest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Watching Mejiro Ardan innocently fly kites 
alongside the children made for a truly 
heartwarming start to the new year—
